_comment: 90 violation records extracted from the violations tables of docs/source/Community_Living_standards_regulations_and_penalties.pdf (Arabic table pages 8-14, English table pages 21-27). The two tables are row-aligned in the source; each record pairs the same row. penalty_egp is the exact figure printed in the source and is authoritative. related_policy_ids link to data/parts/policies.json where the correspondence is explicit in the source.
